comparison.objective: Select a reach rod and press a guarded reset button through a port; candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Reach extension, aperture alignment, and sustained button pressing versus coaxial threaded-tool manipulation and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Requires at least 50 mm rod insertion and a one-second 5 mm press; candidate requires a retained 90° setting, seated nuts, repeated cycles, drift limit, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The record tests choosing and guiding a long rod through a barrier, not setting and locking an adjustable mechanical stop.
